errors.text: The proposed 20–40 h milling and 1100–1250 °C SPS window substantially conflicts with the target regime of 1–6 h milling and 900–1000 °C sintering; the higher exposure risks grain coarsening and phase decomposition.
The requested temperature/strain-rate operating regime is not actually defined: a cooling rate is supplied, but no quantitative deformation or displacement rate is given.

The indentation experiment cannot distinguish grain-refinement strengthening from solute strengthening because it only tests absolute hardness and HCP content; it does not independently vary or quantify grain size at fixed composition and phase fraction.
The cited evidence primarily concerns Al-containing or refractory HEAs rather than equiatomic CoCrFeNiTi, so it does not substantiate the claimed HCP boundaries or selected processing window.
